candidates.evidence: Matches the 120 and 166 cm-1 peaks (Eg- and A1g-type modes of Sb2Te3 recalled at about 113-120 and 165 cm-1). Misses the 80 and 104 cm-1 peaks, which are 10 and 15 cm-1 from the expected low-frequency modes. Literature values are from memory, not checked against a reference in this session.

Recalled Td-WTe2 modes near 84, 113-117, 134 and 163 cm-1 cover 80, 120 and 166 cm-1 within about 4 cm-1. The 104.5 cm-1 peak has no close match and the expected 134 cm-1 mode is absent. Literature values from memory, unverified.
Recalled CrI3 modes near 72, 107, 130 and 166 cm-1 match the 104.5 and 166 cm-1 peaks. The 80 and 120 cm-1 peaks are about 8-10 cm-1 off. Literature values from memory, unverified.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given (material_hint is null), so identification rests on peak positions alone. Four measured Lorentzian-like peaks at 79.6, 104.5, 120.3 and 165.8 cm-1 and no significant features from 170 to 1100 cm-1. No single candidate matches all four peaks within a few cm-1, so the identification is low confidence and not unique.

citations: Literature Raman mode values for Sb2Te3, WTe2 and CrI3 are quoted from memory and were not checked against a reference in this session; treat them as approximate.
Fit: pseudo-Voigt (Lorentzian-dominated) peaks on a quadratic baseline over 60-260 cm-1 with scipy least_squares, after single-point spike removal (6 points, median replacement).
limits: Low confidence and non-unique identification. No candidate matches all four peaks within a few cm-1, and literature values were recalled from memory, not checked against a database or reference.

The spectrum starts at 60 cm-1, so modes below 60 cm-1 and the Rayleigh edge cannot be assessed. A slight rise at the low-frequency end may be filter-edge tail; the residual near 65-72 cm-1 is noise-sized and not reported as a peak.

Above about 170 cm-1 the noise (sigma about 1000 counts) is comparable to the residual features. No peaks above 170 cm-1 pass significance (adding candidate peaks at 188, 294 and 364 cm-1 gave amplitudes at or below 2.2 sigma and raised BIC). Weak modes at 170-1100 cm-1 cannot be excluded, so a material with weak high-frequency bands is not ruled out.
No Si substrate line at 520.7 cm-1 is detectable above the noise (the intensity at 515-525 cm-1 is about 1000-1900 counts, which is noise), so no substrate peak is reported.
The data is a single unpolarized spectrum, so no polarization classification (isotropic, twofold, fourfold) is possible and all pattern fields are null.
Temperature 295 K and 532 nm excitation are used as given; no temperature-dependent or thickness-dependent check was possible.
